row.title: SPINOFF-DEPLOY-1: a launched spinoff must be deployed and probed
row.body: numbers-board and portfolio-board answered 404 because the ultrastable-spinoffs Worker (quniverse account, zone ultrastable.app) was deployed once by hand and never redeployed, and spinoffs/wrangler.toml bound the wrong D1 (ultrastable-ops instead of ultrastable-spinoffs 9e05f27a). Verified live after redeploy: blindspot, numbers-board and portfolio-board all answer 200 (verify-live: GET https://numbers-board.ultrastable.app/api/board expect Managers and loops). spinoff.yml now deploys after rebuild and scripts/probe_spinoffs.py fails on any app not 200. Update the account id when the zone transfer (OL-20261117-4) lands.
